description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarController class for handling calendar-related actions within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for saving, editing, rescheduling, removing, resizing activities, and retrieving activities, managing access control, and integrating with other modules such as CalendarUtils and BeanFactory.

classes.name: CalendarController
classes.description: Controller class managing calendar event operations such as save, edit, reschedule, delete, resize, and retrieve activities, with access control and integration with SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: action_saveactivity
methods.description: Handles saving a calendar activity, including processing recurrence rules, validation, and response with JSON data.

methods.name: action_quickedit
methods.description: Prepares data for quick editing of a calendar record, setting view to 'quickedit' and loading current bean.

methods.name: action_getUser
methods.description: Returns JSON-encoded user information for a given user record.

methods.name: action_reschedule
methods.description: Handles the rescheduling of activities, primarily for drag & drop operations, with validation and data saving.

methods.name: action_remove
methods.description: Deletes a calendar activity or marks it as deleted, with support for recurring events.

methods.name: action_resize
methods.description: Handles resizing (duration change) of calendar activities.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentBean
methods.description: Loads and verifies access to the current activity bean based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getActivities
methods.description: Retrieves and loads activities for the current user or shared user based on the calendar view.
